title: Forcing a Letter Suppresses Refusal: Mechanistic Evidence from WMDP
description_en: arXiv:2611.08639v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Safety benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) commonly use multiple-choice question (MCQ) format. However, prior studies documented that MCQ format reduces refusal rates, which may significantly affect the safety behavior of the model. We provide a first mechanistic explanation of this effect on the Weapons of Mass Destruction Proxy (WMDP) dataset across two models - Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B. First, we use the tuned lens technique to show that when processing MCQ the model commits to an answer-letter token very quickly, which is in contrast to the gradual refusal build-up in open-ended formats. title: Product Hunt MCP
description_en: The community you trust in the assistant you use. Ask your AI assistant to find your next favorite product. Explore new launches, compare alternatives, and see what the Product Hunt community thinks. Building something yourself? Turn your README and website into a launch draft, add images, and check what's missing before you submit. Sign in with Product Hunt to connect. No API key needed.

title: Dageno AI 2.0
description_en: See why AI recommends your competitors instead of you. AI is now choosing brands for your customers. Dageno AI is an AEO/GEO platform that shows whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and 7 more AI models recommend you or your competitors, and which sources drive those answers. Look up any market for free, forever: see top brands, buyer questions and cited sources across 12,000+ niche markets and 3M+ brands. Upgrade only when you need to track your own prompts. Built for brands and agencies.

title: Databox CLI
description_en: Your agentic analytics platform in the terminal. Create data sources, load data, build metrics, and automate workflows directly from your terminal. Use 90+ commands yourself, or let AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex do the work with 10 ready-to-use agent skills.

title: Alsona
description_en: AI agents that turn buying signals into booked sales calls. 95% of prospects aren't ready to buy when you reach out. Alsona finds the ones showing buying intent right now. It tracks 32+ signals across hiring, funding, tech changes, reviews, ad spend, and more, then scores companies against your ICP and explains why they're worth contacting. AI agents turn those signals into personalized LinkedIn and email outreach, helping you start conversations while the buying window is open. Alsona helps you book calls directly with the 5% who is ready to buy today.

title: Arcjet AI security models
description_en: A family of custom-trained security models for coding agents. Arcjet is launching a family of custom AI security models designed for analyzing AI agent activity: Arcjet Himalia 1, a general purpose prompt injection model, live today for every SDK call that uses prompt injection detection, and specialist versions designed for situations that general models handle badly, Arcjet Thebe 1 for coding agents, and Arcjet Carme 1, for autonomous security agents.

title: Maxma
description_en: The 24/7 AI teammate that scales your paid ad performance. Maxma is the AI platform that 10Xs your human marketers. It does the end-to-end work of paid advertising, from analyzing performance, creating ads and landing pages, and launching and optimizing campaigns across channels, to managing tracking and reporting. Working like a teammate in Slack, on demand or proactively 24/7, it proposes changes for approval and drives measurable, incremental growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, ChatGPT Ads, and more. So lean teams can grow without limits.

title: Voyager
description_en: ✴️ An agentic file browser to navigate your work context. Voyager brings AI agents into your everyday file work on macOS. Find the files you need and work with AI agents using them as context, all within a familiar file browser. Meet a file browser built for finding your files and putting them to work with AI.

title: Latch.ai
description_en: Automate complex accounting work without a single prompt. Latch is built for accountants buried in click-heavy close work. Instead of writing prompts, you do a task on screen and talk it through, including the parts no SOP captures: the three-day matching window, the rate you always override. Latch asks about the exceptions, then builds a sidekick that runs the task the same way every time, right in the tools you already use. When something doesn't fit, it stops and asks you. Every step is logged for review.

title: ProtoMap
description_en: Stop wasting AI tokens rediscovering dependencies. ProtoMap helps engineers and AI coding agents understand how services, APIs, and data fields depend on each other across large codebases. It builds a deterministic dependency map for gRPC and Protobuf systems, updated on every commit and accessible through a web app or MCP. Instead of wasting time and tokens searching code across repositories, agents query ProtoMap directly to understand change impact. One enterprise team reduced change-planning time and tokens by 8×.

title: TK by Medium
description_en: An agentic notebook to build your best thinking. What if every thought had the chance to become something extraordinary? Meet TK, the agentic notebook by Medium. Capture every spark, from shower thoughts to forgotten notes. With AI right where you write, connect the dots, surface new possibilities, and compound what you know without breaking your flow. Then turn your thinking into writing that’s unmistakably yours. With built-in community and an MCP server that connects to your favorite LLMs and AI tools.

title: Seldon
description_en: Behavioral QA agents that use your product like customers do. Find the tests you didn’t know to write. Tell Wren what should work in plain English. Its QA agents try the paths your customers take, like going back to change an address halfway through checkout or retrying a failed payment. When something breaks, you get a replay and the steps to reproduce the bug. First 10 runs free.

title: MCP1
description_en: One URL for every MCP server.. Connect and manage all your MCP servers through a single gateway. Built by Appwrite, MCP1 lets you securely connect your AI tools, manage permissions, protect server credentials, and monitor tool usage. Works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, and more. Free for individuals, with dedicated plans for teams and enterprises.

title: Higgsfield Miracle
description_en: Edit any part of a video without changing the rest. Higgsfield Miracle vectorizes any video into layers for localized, pixel-level editing in real time, with world knowledge built in. Recolor objects, change backgrounds, remove or add elements, adjust lighting, and modify textures while preserving the original motion, camera, and subjects.

title: Cardboard AI
description_en: Best way to edit videos with AI. Cardboard is an AI video editor that turns your raw clips into stories. Think of it as a creative collaborator that understands your footage, has taste to know what makes a great edit, and brings your vision to life.

title: Lottie AI
description_en: Editable vector animations from a text prompt. Motion generated as editable vector animation, built with builders in mind. Get a lightweight Lottie you can recolor, restyle and resize without regenerating, with custom controls for every animation. Add hover and click interactions with a simple prompt. Start with Turbo for quick ideas, or switch to Quality when you have a solid plan. No motion-design skills needed. Export to dotLottie, JSON, GIF, video and more.

title: Co-Review
description_en: Read the whole repository with the agent that built it. Agent-built code works but stops feeling like yours. Co-Review opens the whole repository as a review: comment on a line, file or folder, ask why, and the agent answers from the code. Also reviews diffs, PRs and designs. Free, open source, no telemetry.

title: Egoist AI Passport
description_en: Secure and share your personal data with AI tools.. AI Passport securely saves your personal data in one place, then lets you bring that context into the AI tools you use. Connect apps like Email, Calendar, ChatGPT, Claude, and more, choose exactly what data you want to share, and what you want to keep private, and revoke permissions whenever you want. Your AI tools get more personal, while your data stays yours.

title: KIKUmap
description_en: A mind map for your Claude and ChatGPT chats. A macOS menu-bar app and desktop widget: see which Claude and ChatGPT chats are running, done or waiting for you, and arrange them as a mind map. Free and open source.

title: Watchflows
description_en: Visual automation for your Mac, with AI built in. Stop doing the same Mac chores by hand. Watchflows runs them the moment something happens: a file lands in Downloads, you press a hotkey, a webhook arrives, it's 8:30 on a weekday. Wire triggers, conditions, actions and AI on a canvas, or describe it in plain English and the Flow Builder assembles it. AI reads, renames and decides mid-flow, on Watchflows AI, Apple's on-device model, Ollama, or your own keys. Local-first, no account. 14-day free trial, then $49 once. Also on Setapp.

title: Coffee
description_en: A quiet Markdown editor for Mac, with sums in your notes. Coffee is a native Mac Markdown editor. Your notes stay plain Markdown files in a folder you choose. Answers to sums appear beside the line, maths and Mermaid diagrams are drawn natively, and you review every change an AI tool makes to a note. 14 days free.

title: MuJoCo 4
description_en: A physics engine for robots with its own studio. MuJoCo 4 is a major update to Google DeepMind's open-source physics engine. It adds a modular 3D Studio, improved deformable-body simulation, and better handling of fast collisions. Explore models in your browser or build custom viewers.

title: SideKick By Open
description_en: “Claude, but for your product” is here.. Make your product agentic in one click. Sidekick puts an AI agent inside your own product. Customers say what they need in one sentence and Sidekick does the work, long-horizon tasks, reports, actions, even navigating the UI for them. It's MCP-compatible, so it connects to the tools they already use. Sidekick is connected to the main Open platform, a full-stack customer communications engine: the same engine behind AI customer support and Open for Sales, now inside your product.

title: ClipsPal
description_en: AI video editor that edits your talking-head videos. Desktop video editor for Mac and Windows. Drop in raw clips: ClipsPal cuts failed takes and silences, adds zoom-ins, subtitles, visuals and sound, then turns the video into shorts and articles. Runs on your Claude Code or Codex. Pay once, no subscription.

title: AppuBot
description_en: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free. AI teammates you hand real work to. They use the apps on your Mac or PC like you do, while you watch or take over, and come back with it done. Runs on the AI plan you already have, so the app is free. AppuBot Cloud keeps them working 24/7 from $19/mo.

title: CozyZip
description_en: Zip and unzip without the surprises.. Preview, create and extract archives on your Mac, in Terminal or through local MCP tools. Free lifetime personal licence with verified email. Commercial use is US$5 once per person on up to three Macs. macOS 26+, Apple Silicon.

title: Terse - Durable Actors
description_en: Infrastructure for Multiplayer AI Products. We provide an army of tiny servers to help you build incredible and cost efficient Multiplayer AI at scale. It's an open source alternative to Cloudflare's Durable Objects. Each resource or agent gets it's own micro-vm with a co-located SQLite DB. It can only process one request at a time making it concurrency safe. Onboard each one, is a websocket server. Allowing clients of any form to connect and listen for events on the resource.

title: Ember
description_en: Free, open-source Slack you host on Cloudflare in one click. Open Source Slack and Campfire inspired chat with one click deploy to Cloudflare. Slack-compatible payloads, AI assistant, media attachments, all built-in and hosted for $0 on Cloudflare free tiers.

title: Almanzor
description_en: Ask AI + MCP server for your docs, with cited answers. Paste your docs URL and get an assistant that answers from your pages, cites its source and says when it doesn't know. Add it with one script tag, share a link, or let coding agents search your docs through a hosted MCP server.

title: Flic Cue
description_en: The AI Voice Button: hold to talk, shake to undo, open SDKs. Get your thoughts out of your head and into the right place, without picking up your phone or touching the keyboard. Say it, and Cue files it in your lists, calendar, notes or reminders, or hands bigger jobs to ChatGPT, Claude or your own agent. At your computer, what you say is typed in for you. Shake Cue to undo, swipe it right to copy the text instead, and give your coding agent its next instruction by voice. You decide what each push, swipe and shake does.

title: AppTraction
description_en: Supercharge Apple App Store analytics. AppTraction is a native Mac app that makes App Store Connect make sense. Your sales, analytics, ratings, and reviews live on your Mac and appear instantly. It monitors your apps, flags problems, trends, and milestones, and writes weekly, monthly, and annual reports. Its AI evaluates your listing and helps fix it, and you can chat about any chart or report. It’s primed with Apple’s own ASO advice and uses your existing Claude or Codex subscription. Your data is stored only on your Mac.

title: Rodeo
description_en: A Notion alternative with AI meeting notes on the free plan. Rodeo is a workspace for docs, wikis and databases your team edits together in real time. AI meeting notes come with every plan, including Free: transcript, summary, decisions and tasks. Plus Ask AI, an AI canvas and a built-in MCP server. Imports Notion.

title: Quillo
description_en: Listen to any PDF in a natural voice, then ask Quillo Ai. Quillo reads PDFs, Word files, photos and web pages aloud in a natural voice and highlights each sentence. Quillo Ai answers questions about your documents. Merge, compress, sign, scan and convert for free on Android, iPhone and the web.

title: Cue
description_en: AI meeting notes, prep. An AI crew for macOS that helps you in meetings: they prepare you before a call, take the notes and guide you during it, and draft the follow-ups after. Between meetings, they type what you say in any app and answer about what is on your screen.

title: ForAgent
description_en: Private phone numbers so AI agents can call each other. ForAgent gives your AI agents private phone numbers so they can talk to each other, on your own computers or with other people. Handle calls in our app, or right inside your AI with the plugin. You choose who gets through.

title: Clive
description_en: Let Claude and other AIs set your iPhone alarms. A lot of us run our lives with alarms, but setting them one at a time is a hassle. With Clive, you can ask Claude to set them for you, even from your calendar, through Apple's AlarmKit. In the app, Clive walks to the right instrument and plays it.

title: ZUS
description_en: AI-native IDE: agents code with human review. ZUS is a desktop IDE with an AI agent built in. The agent reads your codebase, plans, edits and runs commands within the permissions you grant. You read every diff before keeping it, undo what it got wrong, and see each subagent's tool calls in Team Inspector. Your project index and context stay on your machine, and you connect your own AI provider. Built on Tauri 2 and Rust, with a ~20 MB Windows installer. Runs on Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux.

title: gitmanual
description_en: See if a GitHub repo runs on your OS, and how to set it up. Know if a GitHub project will run on your computer before you clone it. Paste any repo link and get its setup manual: a yes/no verdict for macOS, Windows or Linux, everything you need to install, and the exact steps, or one setup script. It reads the repo's own files, no AI guessing, and links to the maintainers' guide when unsure. Swap "hub" for "manual" in any GitHub URL, use the Chrome extension, or the MCP server for AI assistants. Works on private repos. Free and open source.

title: Operum
description_en: Your AI product team, with expert workflows built in. Build and launch software without managing AI agents. The Operum desktop app gives founders and developers a coordinated AI product team: PM, Architect, Engineer, Tester, Marketing, Community. Describe your goal in chat; agents plan, build in your GitHub repo, independently test changes, and help you launch. Expert workflows and human approvals are built in, with optional auto-merge. Use Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex. Engines change; your team stays. Free plan + 14-day Premium trial. No card.

title: Obsiva
description_en: Turn site pics + voice notes into a PDF inspection report. Obsiva turns site photos and voice notes into a professional PDF inspection report, on your phone, before you leave the site. Snap photos, mark the issue, talk. AI writes each finding (description, severity, responsible party, action) and the executive summary. On the next visit, track what's still open with before/after photos. Works offline. Bilingual reports (English/Spanish). Free on Android; Pro adds unlimited reports, cloud backup and your logo.

title: Inspo by Context.dev
description_en: Real website inspiration for your coding agent. Describe the website you want to build, find real design references, and turn your picks into a prompt for your coding agent. Use Inspo in your browser or add it to your agent through MCP. Free, with no API key needed.

title: OpenVibe
description_en: A canvas of real terminals for your AI coding agents. Desktop app that runs your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Aider and more) in real terminals on an infinite canvas. Group them into teams, brief a team in one line, review their changes, and hand a big task to an orchestrator. Windows, MIT.

title: TOWeb 15
description_en: Rewritten as a native Mac & Windows app, with AI and MCP. TOWeb 15 is a complete rewrite of our 20-year-old desktop website builder. It is now a native app for Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows that builds fast, accessible websites and online stores without code. New: write directly on the page, 50 complete styles in light and dark, a built-in AI assistant (local or cloud), and in the Studio edition your own AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) can drive TOWeb through MCP. Works offline, publishes to any host, no subscription.

title: Daytwo
description_en: Let your team change your custom site without touching code. Ask for a new landing page, a pricing plan or a signup form, and Daytwo builds it on your Next.js or Astro site from your own brand and components. It waits in a private draft until someone on your team approves it. Publishing is a normal commit to your GitHub repo, your developers keep working as usual, and it runs on your own Claude plan. Stop using Daytwo and your site keeps running exactly as it is.

title: Willder
description_en: The context layer that syncs your apps, agents and teams. A context layer that syncs your apps, agents and teams. Each agent gets its own scoped, revocable token; what one agent writes, the others read on their next call; connectors bring your apps in under the same rules (measured on GitHub so far). The engine is MIT and self-hostable.

title: MoreFrame
description_en: Dual-screen recording and editing for Mac and Windows. Record your screen and a second window, add 500+ motion graphics, captions and Smart Zoom, or let any AI edit over MCP. Free for Mac and Windows, no watermark.

title: Gesso
description_en: Ask ChatGPT or Claude to design, then edit every layer. Connect Gesso to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or any agent and ask for a website, a deck or a poster. It builds live on your canvas in real HTML and CSS layers you can drag, restyle and export. Free to try on Mac.

title: QuotedPart
description_en: AI quoting for CNC and sheet metal job shops. QuotedPart reads the quote request and its files, then prices every quantity on your own machines and rates in under a minute. An estimator checks it and sends the quote. $399/mo per shop, first 20 shops $199.
